fields.name: QueryStatement.Create factory family
fields.contract: QueryStatement.Create returns Lazy<QueryStatement> so command text is not read until Value is requested. Every overload accepts a statement name; callers may omit parameter names, supply parameter names, select a folder and extension, or supply a full file path. When materialized, the result is a QueryStatement query contract whose name and parameter names are the supplied values and whose command type is Text.
